draft_en.subject: One question — Marvell Alleycat5 Solution
draft_en.body:
Hi Robert,

You opened our mail on "Marvell Alleycat5 Solution" (and "Managed Optical Bypass Switch") but had no reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

For the CLD-8POE-2SFP-IND industrial PoE switch, we can be a second ODM source on a Marvell platform (DIN-rail 8-PoE + 2 SFP unmanaged or managed, −40~75 °C, CE/RoHS) from small lots in your housing — would a managed variant be useful for your IoT deployments?

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom · sagatele.com
